title: Albright Hereditary Osteodystrophy & Pseudohypoparathyroidism Masterclass
description: 整合 Pseudohypoparathyroidism (PHP-1a, PHP-1b, PPHP) 與 GNAS 基因銘印機制之完整主題講堂。

sections.title: Module 1: GNAS Genomic Imprinting & Tissue-Specific Monoallelic Expression
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Receptor Mapping Matrix

| Tissue / Organ | Allele Expression Pattern | GNAS Loss-of-Maternal Transmission | GNAS Loss-of-Paternal Transmission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Renal Proximal Tubule | Monoallelic (Maternal active, Paternal silenced) | Severe PTH Resistance (PHP-1a: Low Ca, High Pi, High PTH) |PPHP |
| Thyroid Gland | Monoallelic (Maternal active, Paternal silenced) | Subclinical/TSH Resistance | Normal Thyroid Axis Function |
| Skeletal Tissue & Subcutis | Biallelic (Both Maternal & Paternal active) | Albright Hereditary Osteodystrophy (AHO: Short Stature, Brachydactyly) | Albright Hereditary Osteodystrophy (AHO: Somatic Features Present) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | PHP-Pseudohypoparathyroidism 1a |Pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism | PHP-Pseudohypoparathyroidism 1b |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Inheritance Pathway | Maternal Transmission of GNAS Inactivating Mutation | Paternal Transmission of GNAS Inactivating Mutation | STX16 Microdeletion / Loss of Imprinting at GNAS A/B |
| AHO Phenotype | Present (Short Stature, Round Face, Brachydactyly) |Identical Somatic Features to PHP-1a |Isolated Endocrine Resistance |
| PTH Resistance | Present (Hypocalcemia, Hyperphosphatemia, High Intact PTH) | Absent (Normal Calcium, Phosphate, Intact PTH) |Renal Selective PTH Resistance |
| TSH Resistance | Present (Elevated TSH, Low-Normal Free T4) | Absent | Absent or Mild |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Heterozygous GNAS Mutation ➔ Maternal Transmission ➔ Renal Proximal Tubule Paternal Allele Silenced by Promoter Methylation ➔ Complete Loss of Functional Gsα in Proximal Tubule ➔ Defective Adenylyl Cyclase Activation by PTH1R ➔ Reduced Urinary cAMP & Phosphate Excretion ➔ Hypocalcemia & Hyperphosphatemia +PHP-1a.

Heterozygous GNAS Mutation ➔ Paternal Transmission ➔ Renal Proximal Tubule Active Maternal Allele Supplies Normal Gsα ➔ Normal Renal PTH & TSH Responsiveness ➔PPHP.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 誤將 PHP-1a 與 PPHP 判定為兩種完全不同基因突變引起的疾病。
**Analysis**: PHP-1a 與 PPHP 可發生於同一個家族中（如母女或父女傳遞相同之 GNAS 失能突變）。Parent-of-Origin Transmission：母源傳遞帶有腎小管 Gsα 缺失引發 PHP-1a；父源傳遞則因腎小管有未沉寂的母源野生型等位基因支應，僅呈現骨骼 AHO PPHP。

**Trap**: 混淆 PHP-1a 與 PHP-1b 在臨床體徵與表觀遺傳學上的分野。
**Analysis**: PHP-1a 為 GNAS 編碼區突變，具有顯著的 AHO 外觀；PHP-1b 則主因為 STX16 Loss of Imprinting，典型表型為孤立性腎臟 PTH 阻抗，完全無 AHO Without Skeletal Involvement。

sections.title: Module 2: End-Organ Hormone Resistance & Calcitriol Replacement Safety Management
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Laboratory Diagnostic Matrix

| Disease Entity | Serum Calcium | Serum Phosphate | Intact PTH | Urinary Calcium | Serum TSH |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| PHP-1a | Low | High | Markedly Elevated |Renal Resistance |TSH Resistance |
| Primary Hypoparathyroidism | Low | High | Low / Inappropriately Normal | Low | Normal |
|ADH | Low | High | Low / Low-Normal |Hypercalciuria | Normal |
| Vitamin D Dependent Rickets Type 1 | Low | Low / Normal | Elevated | Low | Normal |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature |PHP-1a |ADH | Primary Hypoparathyroidism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Underlying Defect |GNAS Loss-of-Function | Activating Mutation of Calcium-CaSR | Glandular Destruction /PTH Secretion Failure |
| Intact PTH Level |Compensatory High | Low or Inappropriately Low-Normal | Low or Undetectable |
| Urinary Calcium Excretion | Reduced |Hypercalciuria Risk | Reduced |
| Therapeutic Caution | Requires Calcitriol + Calcium; Avoid Hypercalciuria | High Risk of Nephrocalcinosis & Renal Failure with Calcium Therapy | Requires Active Vitamin D Analogues |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Diagnosis of PHP-1a ➔Calcitriol & Oral Calcium Carbonate ➔ Bypasses Impaired 1-alpha-hydroxylase Activation ➔ Restores Intestinal Calcium Absorption ➔ Normalizes Serum Ionized Calcium ➔ Mitigates Neuromuscular Irritability & Muscle Cramps.

Long-term Management ➔ Monitor Serum Calcium & Urine Calcium-to-Creatinine Ratio ➔ Keep Serum Calcium in Low-Normal Range (8.0-8.5 mg/dL) ➔ Prevents Hypercalciuria & Iatrogenic Nephrocalcinosis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 盲目追求將 PHP-1a 9.5-10.5 mg/dL。
**Analysis**: 腎小管遠端重吸收鈣的作用在一定程度上仍受高 PTH 影響，若過度補鈣及 Calcitriol，會劇烈增加尿鈣排泄，Hypercalciuria Nephrocalcinosis。KDIGO 8.0-8.5 mg/dL，以安全預防症狀為核心目標。

sections.title: Module 3: Phenotypic Spectrum of Pseudohypoparathyroidism Subtypes (PHP-1a vs 1b vs 1c vs 2)
sections.content:
### 1. Subtype Classification Matrix

| Subtype | GNAS Gene Defect | Gsα Protein Level | Urinary cAMP Response to exogenous PTH | Urinary Phosphate Response to PTH | AHO Phenotype |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| PHP-1a |Maternal | Reduced (~50%) | Blunted / Absent | Blunted / Absent | Present |
| PHP-1b |STX16 | Normal in non-imprinted tissues | Blunted / Absent in Kidney | Blunted / Absent | Absent |
| PHP-1c |Maternal |Catalytic site intact | Blunted / Absent | Blunted / Absent | Present |
| PHP-2 | Post-receptor Signaling Defect | Normal |cAMP rises | Blunted / Absent | Absent |

### 2. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Exogenous PTH Infusion Test ➔ Measure Urinary cAMP Elevation ➔ If Urinary cAMP Fails to Increase ➔ Classify as Type 1 Resistance (PHP-1a, 1b, or 1c).

Exogenous PTH Infusion Test ➔ Urinary cAMP Increases Normally BUT Phosphate Excretion Fails to Increase ➔ Distal Signal Transduction Defect Downstream of cAMP ➔ Diagnose PHP-2.

### 3. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為所有 PTH 阻抗患者的尿液 cAMP 對外源性 PTH 刺激都不會有反應。
**Analysis**: 在 PHP-2 中，受體與 Gsα 蛋白的偶聯作用完全正常，因此外源性 PTH 能正常引發尿液 cAMP 大幅上升；然而因 cAMP Protein Kinase A NaPi-IIa 的信號傳遞障礙，導致磷排泄無法增加。這是 PHP-1 與 PHP-2 在 Ellsworth-Howard 測試中的核心鑑別點。
